# Agritourism Adventures

> Agritourism Adventures connects travelers with Kenya's farms, cultures, and countryside through immersive, eco-conscious adventures. We offer sustainable tourism experiences that support local communities and regenerative agriculture practices.

## Core Pages
- [About Us](https://agritourke.lovable.app/about): Learn about our mission, team, and commitment to sustainable tourism in Kenya
- [Our Tours](https://agritourke.lovable.app/tours): Browse our curated agritourism experiences across Kenyan farms and communities
- [Services](https://agritourke.lovable.app/services): Discover our educational tours, cultural experiences, and farm-to-table programs
- [FAQ](https://agritourke.lovable.app/faq): Answers to common questions about visiting, booking, safety, and sustainability

## Resources
- [Blog](https://agritourke.lovable.app/blog): Articles on sustainable agriculture, travel tips, and Kenyan farm experiences
- [Gallery](https://agritourke.lovable.app/gallery): Visual showcase of our tours and partner farms
